description: Create a new container registry. 'storageType' selects the storage backend: 'objectStorage' (default) reuses an existing Object Storage bucket (then 'bucket' is required); 'ncloudStorage' auto-provisions dedicated NCR storage (then 'bucket' is ignored). Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

bucket.description: Object Storage bucket name. Required when storageType='objectStorage' (the default); ignored when storageType='ncloudStorage'. Cannot be reused across registries.

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the registry

storageType.description: Storage backend. 'objectStorage' (default) reuses an existing Object Storage bucket — 'bucket' is then required. 'ncloudStorage' auto-provisions dedicated NCR storage (bucket 'registry-{privateId}') — 'bucket' is ignored.

name: ncloud_ncr_create_registry
